fixes.explanation: Ooh, careful, friend! I've been tripped up by easier ones than this, and I live on a cookie planet. Paul writes, "He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever." Those gifts are scattered abroad, and they go to the poor. No trick in this one, so True was the answer.

Sacrifices is a fair guess, friend, and I've grabbed the wrong word off the shelf plenty of times myself. But it isn't in this verse. Paul says "…through us your generosity will produce thanksgiving to God." The generosity goes out, and what it produces is thanksgiving.
